name: ClauseGuard — AI Policy Risk Analyzer
description: Real-time T&C & Privacy Policy risk analysis with inline annotations, personalized risk profiles, and policy change monitoring. All processing happens on-device — no data leaves your browser.
_comment_mv2: For Firefox: change manifest_version to 2, replace background.service_worker with background.scripts, replace action with browser_action, and remove _comment_mv2.
_comment_safari: Safari requires an Xcode project wrapper. Use safari-web-extension-builder to convert this MV3 manifest.
